Name: (AT) Witchy Goblincore Beds
Author: AtlasV1224
Description:
[list]
[*]Ever thought the basic beds were lack-lustre?
[*]Liked the original wood frames but the covers didn't quite match your house?
[*]Want your bed to match the rug below?
[/list]

This is the mod for you!

This mod takes [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20640]Shyzie's witchy goblincore rugs[/url] and turns them into beds!

Each of the 8 rug textures has 6 different wood variants making 48 total variants!
The textures are added to the default bed.


I highly recommend adding Shyzie's rugs to your game, they are fantastic decorative pieces.

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]


Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/38980835]Shyzie[/url] for giving me permission to use your textures in this mod!
